vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-23906
vulnerability.description: Timing side-channel in Apache Druid basic-security extension allows username enumeration and hash comparison oracle.

statements.justification: The fix from Apache Druid 36.0.0 has been backported to this build. Changes include: (1) dummy hash computation for non-existent users to prevent timing-based username enumeration, (2) MessageDigest.isEqual() for constant-time hash comparison to prevent hash oracle attacks, (3) uniform HTTP error responses without message bodies to prevent user enumeration via response content. Affected files: MetadataStoreCredentialsValidator.java, LdapUserPrincipal.java, BasicHTTPAuthenticator.java.
